subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go/minimax-m3 thinking content leaks to channel via Anthropic Messages path

question: Should a future fix require redacted live opencode-go/minimax-m3 proof before choosing between a disabled-thinking payload and a proxy-specific sanitizer?
rationale: Source inspection proves the current wrapper gap, but current MiniMax M3 code documents a real message-delivery risk for disabled-thinking payloads, and the prior replacement PR was closed over exactly that proof gap.

options.title: Require proof before landing
options.body: Accept a provider-local fix only after redacted live opencode-go/minimax-m3 proof shows reasoning is hidden and final answer text still arrives; use a sanitizer if disabled thinking drops output.

options.title: Accept disabled thinking risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally force disabled thinking for the proxy model, but that may trade a privacy fix for empty or degraded replies without live evidence.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Leave the issue open but defer implementation until a reporter or maintainer provides a fresh transcript, logs, or terminal run showing the proxy leak.

recommendation.title: Require proof before landing
recommendation.body: Accept a provider-local fix only after redacted live opencode-go/minimax-m3 proof shows reasoning is hidden and final answer text still arrives; use a sanitizer if disabled thinking drops output.

likelyOwner.reason: This account appears in both the opencode-go reasoning sanitizer history and the prior MiniMax reasoning-leak mitigation path, making it the best available routing owner for the proof standard.
